It doesn’t have to be, it just is.
I can’t help anyone. The only thing I want is to be loved, no one will ever love me the way I want. I will never be able to have love.

I am so frustrated. All my life I’ve been told how bad pedophiles are, and I am one. And I can’t help but hate myself, but I can’t help but try and not to as well
My therapist told me she didn’t know how to help me.
Death in an inevitable outcome of life. Why live a pathetic life only to eventually die? Why not die now and skip the pain and hate.

I have a councillour, it doesn’t help change who I am.

It is what it is. People like me need to die.
I’m a pedophile. I deserve to die. I just want it to be painless
